verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents Graph driveItem addressing, search, delta, change notifications, versions, sharing and uploads. Nothing describes custom metadata or property templates on files that a developer can set and query via the API. The only metadata mention is a community remark that SharePoint adds its own metadata to documents, which is not a developer-defined schema.

support.subject: As a developer, files carry my schema — custom metadata/properties templates that can be set and queried via the API
